pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Prana is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A warm, sunlit studio with mats laid out on a wood floor

children: We opened Prana because so many studios felt like they were for someone else — already flexible, already calm, already sure of the words. We wanted a room for the rest of us.
So this is a place to start, and a place to stay. All levels in the same class, taught kindly, capped small, with teachers who learn your name and meet you exactly where you are.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: No special clothes, no experience, no flexibility required. Bare feet, an open hour, and a mat we’ll lend you if you don’t have one.
Pay per class or become a member — whichever fits your life. Memberships are month-to-month, and your first class is always free.
We build the schedule around balance: something strong, something slow, and a community flow that’s open to everyone, pay-what-you-can.
